schemas.domain: Equinix Fabric Agent Factory On Event
schemas.title: OnEvent
schemas.description: Equinix Fabric Agent Factory Event-Driven Scenarios

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Monitoring and Upgrade Package Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that continuously monitors route usage on a Fabric Cloud Router.

agentFactories.name: Connection Bandwidth Monitoring and Upgrade Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that automatically upgrades the bandwidth of a connection when usage reaches a certain threshold.

agentFactories.name: Connection Bandwidth Monitoring and Upgrade Redundant Connection Agent
agentFactories.description: This automated agent monitors Equinix Fabric connections and maintains bandwidth parity between redundant connection pairs.

agentFactories.name: Connection High Latency Auto-Runbook Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that runs an automated diagnostic runbook when a metro latency alert fires.

agentFactories.name: Connection Packet Drop Monitoring and Upgrade Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that automatically boosts connection bandwidth to mitigate traffic-induced packet loss.

agentFactories.name: Metro Latency Spikes and Connections Over Metros Report Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that automatically email a list of connections that are over the metros where latency spike.

schemas.domain: Equinix Fabric Agent Factory On Schedule
schemas.title: OnSchedule
schemas.description: Equinix Fabric Agent Factory On Schedule and On Demand Scenarios

agentFactories.name: Alert Rule Manager Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that sets up an alert rule for a connection.

agentFactories.name: Asset Pending State Tracker Agent
agentFactories.description: This agent actively analyzes the lifecycle state of Equinix Fabric assets to identify those stuck in provisioning or deprovisioning phases for an extended period, proactively notifying user.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Attachment Audit Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that audits Fabric Cloud Routers to detect routers that are unmonitored and attach to stream.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router BGP Bootstrap Provisioner Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent targets a connection that is pending interface configuration, sets up a standard BGP routing protocol, and sends a completion notification with final execution outcome.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Connection BGP Session Restart Agent (Scheduled Batch)
agentFactories.description: An Equinix scheduled agent that evaluates BGP session health for Fabric Cloud Router backed connections and performs narrow bounded remediation only when needed.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Management Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that creates a Fabric Cloud Router with user-specified parameters.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Ping and Report Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that initiates a PING command on a Fabric Cloud Router in order to perform a network connectivity check.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Route Aggregation Recommendation Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that recommends, or suggests, aggregate routes for a Fabric Cloud Router.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Traceroute and Report Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that initiates a TRACEROUTE command on a Fabric Cloud Router in order to perform a network connectivity check.

agentFactories.name: Cloud Router Upgrade Package Agent
agentFactories.description: This definition sets up and activates an Equinix agent that upgrades the package of a Fabric Cloud Router.

agentFactories.name: Connection Attachment Audit Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that audits Fabric connections to detect that are unmonitored and attach to stream.

agentFactories.name: Connection Bandwidth Upgrade Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that upgrades the bandwidth of a connection.

agentFactories.name: Connection Health Scorecard Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix Agent that gives operators a single-pane health view across Equinix Fabric connections. It collects per-connection performance metrics, computes a composite 0 to 100 health score for each connection, ranks them, flags any connection with an obvious measurable issue, and recommends remediation for every flagged connection.

agentFactories.name: Connection Pending State Tracker Agent
agentFactories.description: This agent analyzes the lifecycle state of Equinix Fabric connections to identify those stuck in provisioning or deprovisioning state longer than a configured threshold, proactively notifying the user when action may be needed.

agentFactories.name: Daily Asset Change Report Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix Agent that identifies connections, ports, cloud routers, networks, internet access, and network edge change events in past 24 hours.

agentFactories.name: Daily Asset Creation Report Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix Agent that identifies connections, ports, cloud routers, networks, internet access, and network edge creation events in past 24 hours.

agentFactories.name: IPWAN & Cloud Router Network Setup Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that provisions a single IPWAN-based network topology with FCR.

agentFactories.name: Port Attachment Audit Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that audits all Fabric Ports to detect ports that are unmonitored then attachs them to stream.

agentFactories.name: Port Pending State Tracker Agent
agentFactories.description: This agent analyzes the lifecycle state of Equinix Fabric ports to identify those stuck in provisioning or deprovisioning state longer than a configured threshold, proactively notifying the user when action may be needed.

agentFactories.name: Project Lifecycle Activities Insight Report Agent
agentFactories.description: This reporting agent analyzes all cloud events within a given Equinix Fabric project over a specified time range and delivers a plain-English operational health summary report via email. This agent runs once immediately by default unless scheduled by user.

agentFactories.name: Resource Stuck State Timeout Notifier Agent
agentFactories.description: This agent identifies Equinix Fabric connections, ports, and routers stuck in a `PROVISIONING` or `DEPROVISIONING` state past a configurable timeout.

agentFactories.name: Stream Attachment Cloud Router Finder Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that automatically detects new routers older than a certain amount of time and ensures they are at least connected to the default stream.

agentFactories.name: Stream Attachment Connection Finder Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that automatically detects new connections older than a certain amount of time and ensures they are at least connected to the default stream.

agentFactories.name: Stream Attachment Port Finder Agent
agentFactories.description: An Equinix agent that automatically detects new ports older than a certain amount of time and ensures they are at least connected to the default stream.
